body:
Small nits from a code review, none urgent, fine to do in one pass:

- cmd_init prints "initialized tracker branch..." even when it already existed; say "already initialized at ..." on idempotent reruns (commands.py:129-137)
- _would_introduce_cycle prints a warning to stderr from inside the tracker layer (tracker.py:410); layering smell — consider returning warnings to the caller
- _bootstrap_worktree duplicates the VERSION-writing logic of _write_version (tracker.py:120-129); could call _write_version(commit=False)
title: Cosmetic cleanups: init message, cycle-check layering, VERSION write DRY
